Lead your party to the [[Ascalon Settlement]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}
* [[Mhenlo's Request]] not active

===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Devona]].
* Lead your party north to the Ascalon Settlement.
* See [[Captain Greywind]] [Skills] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{w}} {{skill icon|Final Thrust}}
* {{r}} {{skill icon|Throw Dirt}}
* {{mo}} {{skill icon|Heal Other}}
* {{n}} {{skill icon|Enfeeble}}
* {{me}} {{skill icon|Wastrel's Worry}}
* {{e}} {{skill icon|Lightning Orb}}

==Walkthrough==
Immediately after entering North Kryta Province, a [[North Kryta Province#Dialogue|dialogue]] starts between [[Damaris]] and the four ascalonian NPCs. Wait until the end, then talk to Damaris then [[Devona]].

With [[Aidan]], [[Cynn]], Devona, and [[Mhenlo]] following you, walk to the settlement marked on your map (at the northwest corner of the explorable area) and talk to Captain Greywind. Devona must survive to obtain the rewards.

Several routes are possible: the route displayed in red on the picture has a few [[Bog Skale]]s and no [[North Kryta Province (War in Kryta)|War in Kryta spawns]] (should [[War in Kryta]] be active), while the purple route has War in Kryta spawns and many [[Tengu]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Damaris
:''"I've been trying to tell your friends here how to get to the '''Ascalon Settlement''', but the rude woman keeps interrupting me. The Settlement {{sic|Unlike Devona's dialogue below, 'Settlement' is capitalized here}} is '''northwest''' of here. You should be able to follow the signs and get there safely. Perhaps you could lead your friends there, <character name>? I would take you myself, but there are rumors that the [[Shining Blade]] has been seen in the area.''

:''Will you lead your friends to the Ascalon Settlement?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'm happy to help.
| decline = They can find their own way.
| ask = The '''Ascalon Settlement''' is to the '''northwest'''. Be careful my friend, there are worse things on the road than those Shining Blade scoundrels.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
At start:
:'''Devona:''' ''"We should get going. The sooner we can get to the settlement, {{sic|Unlike Damaris' dialogue above, 'settlement' is lowercase here}} the better. I hear Captain Greywind is overseeing things, so we should check with him when we get there. Lead the way, <character name>, and we'll follow."''

At the entry to the settlement:
:'''Devona:''' ''"At last! The Ascalon Settlement. We should locate Captain Greywind with all haste."''

Reaching Greywind:
:'''Devona:''' ''"Thank you for your companionship on the journey, <character name>. As always, it was a pleasure to fight at your side."''
:'''Mhenlo:''' ''"Farewell, <character name>. May [[Dwayna]] keep you safe and [[Balthazar]] lend you strength."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Captain Greywind
:''Welcome to our new home. I can't help but think that it's tragic for us to have fought so hard and come so far only to land in a place like this. [[Ettin]]s and Tengu assault us from all sides, not to mention those [[skale]] and [[imp]]s. To make matters worse, we are lacking in all but the most basic supplies. Still, this land is bountiful, and with a lot of hard work, we should be able to prosper here.''

==Notes== 
* Captain Greywind will not spawn if you have the Wintersday quest [[A Very Grentchie Wintersday]] task "Travel to the Ascalon Settlement with the Grentch and destroy all the Wintersday gifts from Dwayna. 0 of 7 Wintersday gifts remaining." active.
* This quest combines well with [[Merchant's Plea]] and [[The Last Hog]].
** Consider also taking [[The Weaver of Nebo]], especially if you plan on taking [[Blankets for the Settlers]] from Captain Greywind, as it is not much further to [[Nebo Terrace]].
* Players can use this quest for farming experience/drops quickly thanks to the help of the several fairly good allies it provides.

==Trivia==
*This quest was added in the [[Game updates/20050615|June 15, 2005 update]].
